key_points: Host Hotels (BXP) Q3 FFO beat estimates with 8.8% RevPAR growth, indicating strong demand.
Management raised full-year earnings and revenue guidance, signaling improved outlook.
Positive sector momentum from peer REITs beating estimates may support investor confidence.
No regulatory, legal, or M&A developments that would offset the positive sentiment.
Guidance upgrade suggests the stock could see upward price pressure over the next weeks.
